props.name: children
props.description: The content that shatters. It stays mounted while dismissed, so its state survives an undo.

props.name: shattered
props.description: Controlled dismissed state. `false` after `true` plays the undo.

props.name: onShatteredChange
props.description: Called when the close button, `shatter()` or `restore()` asks for a change.

props.name: onShattered
props.description: Fires once the last shard has faded.

props.name: onRestored
props.description: Fires once the real element is back.

props.name: floor
props.description: Pixels below the element where shards land and bounce; `false` lets them fall away.

props.name: edges
props.description: Hairline highlights on the shard edges, like cut glass.

props.name: collapse
props.description: Close the gap the element leaves, and reopen it before an undo.

props.name: closeButton
props.description: Show the built-in close button in the top-right corner.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close button.

props.name: focusTarget
props.description: Where focus goes when the element is dismissed while it holds focus.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Classes for the element that shatters.
